payload.rationale:
All fourteen criteria of this epic are cascade-complete over contributing inputs that carry passing evidence. The criteria themselves carry no evidence directly and none is owed: they are aggregation gate predicates whose closure mode is cascade, satisfied when the decomposition completes rather than authored against. The evidence sits one level down, on the ten solution children, every one of which is finished. Delivery coverage stands at 67/67, no criterion is cascade-incomplete, and no contributor was in flight, so the outcome is delivered with no waivers.

The epic delivered what it set out to: the control logic reaches hardware only through a named interface with a host-simulated implementation behind it, the plant structure sits behind its own named interface with parameters carried as data, three structures stand behind that seam with the reference machine's description populated and the origin of each value recorded, each structure declares the actuation channels it answers and the support status hardware verification gives it, and the host tier exercises the whole under memory and undefined-behaviour analysis with an automated mutation sweep whose population follows the tree and whose every mutant is killed or judged.

The eight requirement criteria this epic targets that had become review-ready were settled before this seal rather than after it, because sealing forecloses the remedy if a review finds an intent gap. Seven were attested, each against the delivered firmware rather than against the evidence beneath it, and each records the residuals of the gate it rests on rather than claiming coverage the gate does not give.

The eighth, REQ-MODEL-STRUCTURE-SEAM-001.C2, was not attested. That criterion names the control law, the estimator and the fault detection as the consumers the seam must serve, and none of the three is behind the interface yet: the seam's consumers today are the native harness and three test suites. What this epic established is that the interface can be shared, not that it is shared by the consumers the requirement names, and no harness can settle that. Its only two contributors were this epic and an already-finished solution, so this seal would have left it with nothing live to establish it. It is re-anchored onto DEL-SIM-ESTIMATOR and DEL-SIM-BREW-LOOP, which bring two of its three named consumers behind the seam. The third, fault detection, has no deliverable anywhere in the roadmap today, so when those two finish, C2 will present as cascade-complete with that consumer still absent and the judgement will have to be made again. It is recorded here so that recurrence is expected rather than discovered.

REQ-PREENERGISATION-VERIFICATION-001.C1 was likewise re-anchored, onto the two loops that exercise the control law against the plant model, before this seal.

Sealed under the solo governance profile.

Both criteria are met by the single contributing solution, and its evidence is recorded against all five of its own criteria.

The range of model error the design assumes is now declared per value and carried in the plant description itself, by the route the origin of a value already travels, and is read back through the plant-model seam without naming a structure — so the sensitivity and robustness work that consumes it stays structure-agnostic as intended.

The behaviours that must survive an arbitrarily wrong model are separated from those permitted to degrade, as checkable data rather than prose. The separation is drawn in three classes rather than two: a guarantee that holds whatever the model says and one that holds only across the declared error are different promises, and the robustness verification checks them by different means — the first by making the model arbitrarily wrong, the second by sweeping the range. Collapsing them would have hidden exactly the distinction the consumer acts on.

One discovery was carried forward rather than left in prose: the declared error states size and not shape, and the reference machine's element ratings are correlated and one-sided. That is now DEL-SIM-ROBUSTNESS-VERIFICATION.C5 rather than a note beside the numbers.

All five aggregation criteria are cascade-complete over four finished contributing solutions, and none is owed evidence directly: they are gate predicates whose closure mode is cascade, satisfied when the decomposition completes. The evidence sits one level down, on the solutions' own criteria, every one of which carries a passing node.

The task set out to produce a state estimator and the residual it reports. It ends with a seam that reconstructs the temperature of the water on its way to the group -- a state no sensor on this machine reports -- from the four channels that do exist, reports the difference the correction consumed, refuses a reading the machine could not plausibly have produced, carries the reconstruction on prediction across a brief loss and declines to answer once the loss is no longer brief, and is advanced by the interval that actually elapsed rather than the one the loop is nominally meant to run at.

What it does not establish is anything about timing on hardware. No worst-case duration, deadline margin or completion time is asserted anywhere beneath this task, and no test measures one -- that claim belongs to OBL-REALTIME-DISCIPLINE-001 and to the on-target tier, which does not exist yet. Nor does it claim the declared bounds, windows and tolerances are quantitatively right for the reference machine: every figure is declared with its origin and every origin says it was estimated, because nothing has been on a bench. Whether the tolerance window is short enough that the process cannot become hazardous while the machine drives on prediction is owned by REQ-UNOBSERVED-ACTUATION-BOUND-001, which is uncovered and stays that way; the same is true of REQ-SENSOR-LIVENESS-001. Both surface as requirement-chain health here rather than as work this task left undone.

Both contributing solutions are cascade-complete: SOL-PLANT-FLOW-REPORTED (6/6 criteria evidenced, merged previously) and SOL-PLANT-FLOW-ENERGY-BALANCE (14/14 criteria evidenced this branch, fresh-context blind review clean, task fw:verify clean including a 96% mutation-sweep kill rate with every survivor judged). No in-flight solutions remain under this task.

All six aggregation criteria are cascade-complete over four contributing solutions, every one of which carries passing evidence: SOL-PLANT-STEAM-DRAW-CHANNELS (demand input and steam feed channel), SOL-PLANT-STEAM-DRAW-ENERGY (latent-heat loss term, pressure divergence and reversion), SOL-PLANT-STEAM-DRAW-REPORTED (the draw rate as a seam quantity) and SOL-PLANT-STEAM-DRAW-DESCRIBED (the description's relations, interfaces and omissions). Delivery coverage is 6/6 with no criterion cascade-incomplete, no violated evidence, and no contributor in flight, so the outcome is delivered with no waivers. The criteria themselves carry no direct evidence and none is owed: they are aggregation gate predicates closing by cascade.

The task delivered what it set out to. Opening the wand now costs the steam mass energy through the latent heat of what is drawn, so a draw of any length no longer looks like no draw at all and a steam loop can be judged on rejecting it. Demand and feed are separated as the task required -- the rate is supplied from outside the control law and cannot be commanded, while the feed has an actuation channel of its own -- and steam pressure diverges from a function of steam temperature while a draw is open, which is what leaves the choice of regulated quantity open to simulation rather than settled by the shape of the model.

Two limits are sealed knowingly rather than overlooked, both stated in the plant description rather than left implied. The steam balance charges the latent heat of what is vaporised and does not charge the block for raising the replacement water to the temperature it vaporises at, so the steam side droops less under a draw than a real block would, by roughly a seventh at the declared coefficients and more on a colder feed. And the steam feed channel is answered by the structure while no relation reads it, so nothing here bounds how fast steam can be made. Neither is a shortfall against a criterion of this task: C1's operative test is that the loss depends on the rate drawn rather than widening with valve position, which is built, and C6 asks that the feed be commanded on its own channel, which it is. Both are fidelity gaps that no criterion in the graph currently requires closing, and placing them is follow-on work rather than a waiver here.
